messages.en: It's just in Seksyen 7. I'll send you the location so you can find it easily.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 属于中性行政和地址用语。称呼负责人时使用其姓名或合适称谓，ketua seksyen 是职务名称。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 提供地址时写全城镇、Seksyen 编号及必要门牌；引用法条时保留准确编号和法令名称，不能仅凭 seksyen 一词判断具体规定。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 属于中性行政和地址用语。称呼负责人时使用其姓名或合适称谓，ketua seksyen 是职务名称。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 提供地址时写全城镇、Seksyen 编号及必要门牌；引用法条时保留准确编号和法令名称，不能仅凭 seksyen 一词判断具体规定。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies seksyen as an English borrowing, corresponding to section. Its Malaysian meanings connect several ways of dividing a larger whole: an office into units, a law into provisions, a platoon into smaller units, and a town into numbered areas. An address and an organizational chart therefore provide two useful cultural pictures of the same word. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=+seksyen).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到 seksyen，就联想到英语 section：把一个整体分成一块——部门、法条、军班、城区都能套用。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节词；sy 表示单一辅音 /ʃ/，不是 /s/ 与 /j/ 的组合；词尾 /k/ 在马来西亚常实现为 [ʔ]。派生词 mengesyaki 保留 sy，并使用 menge-。

senses.zh_definition: 对人、事或某项说法缺乏信任或把握而产生的怀疑、疑虑或猜疑。
senses.en_definition: Doubt, suspicion, or uncertainty arising from a lack of trust or confidence.
senses.ms_definition: Rasa kurang percaya atau kurang yakin; curiga, sangsi atau waswas.
senses.nuances: 可指一般疑虑，也可指对他人的猜疑；本身不表示已经掌握证据。menaruh syak 表示心存怀疑；tidak syak lagi 表示毫无疑问。syak wasangka 须分写。[DBP 释义与拼写说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=syak)

senses.zh_definition: 【口语】怀疑；在尚未证实的情况下猜想某种情况属实。
senses.en_definition: Informally, to suspect or suppose that something is the case.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa percakapan, menaruh syak atau menduga sesuatu; mengesyaki.
senses.nuances: 常见于 saya syak 或 aku syak，属于口语动词用法；正式叙述宜用 mengesyaki。此处马来文为用法释义，不冒充 DBP 独立列出的第二义项。[马来语词类记录](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/syak)

collocations.ms: syak ada sesuatu yang tidak kena

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kelewatan penyerahan dokumen itu menimbulkan syak terhadap ketelusan proses berkenaan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 延迟提交文件一事引发了对有关程序透明度的怀疑。
dual_scenarios.en: The delay in submitting the documents raised doubts about the transparency of the process.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku syak mesej tu palsu lah. Dia nak kita bayar cepat sangat.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya mengesyaki mesej itu palsu kerana pengirimnya mendesak kita membuat bayaran dengan segera.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我怀疑那条消息是假的啦，对方一直催我们赶快付款。
dual_scenarios.en: I reckon that message is fake. They're pushing us to pay straight away.
spoken_features: aku 是熟人之间使用的非正式第一人称。
syak 在这里作口语动词，正式形式为 mengesyaki。
tu 对应 itu；nak 对应 hendak。
lah 表示说话人的判断或强调，并非固定表示礼貌。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku syak mesej tu palsu lah. Kau dah tekan pautan dia ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya mengesyaki mesej itu palsu. Adakah kamu sudah menekan pautan dalam mesej tersebut?
messages.zh: 我怀疑那条消息是假的啦。你已经点里面的链接了吗？
messages.en: I think that message is fake. Have you clicked the link?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum. Aku baca je tadi. Kita semak kat laman rasmi dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Belum. Saya hanya membacanya tadi. Mari kita membuat semakan di laman rasmi dahulu.
messages.zh: 还没，我刚才只是看了一下。我们先去官方网站查查。
messages.en: No, I only read it. Let's check the official website first.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 Saya syak awak... 会明显表达不信任；面对同事、长辈或客户，可先说 Saya ingin mendapatkan penjelasan...，再说明具体疑点。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合表达尚待核实的疑虑。谈论个人品行或涉嫌行为时，应清楚区分猜疑、指控与已证实事实；朋友之间的 aku、kau 不宜自动用于正式交往。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 直接说 Saya syak awak... 会明显表达不信任；面对同事、长辈或客户，可先说 Saya ingin mendapatkan penjelasan...，再说明具体疑点。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合表达尚待核实的疑虑。谈论个人品行或涉嫌行为时，应清楚区分猜疑、指控与已证实事实；朋友之间的 aku、kau 不宜自动用于正式交往。

etymology.historical_story: Syak comes from Arabic shakk, meaning doubt. Malay adapted the sound into a single syllable written with sy, while Jawi retained the recognisable Arabic consonants. Its everyday expressions cover both suspicion and certainty: adding tidak and lagi produces tidak syak lagi, an emphatic assurance that something is beyond doubt. [Etymology](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/syak); [Malay expressions](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=syak).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /ʃak/ 想成心里突然一声“嘘，先别信！”：syak 就是疑心升起。此联想仅助记，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是附着于词尾的强调小品词，不改变 sama 的基本词义或词类，也不引起辅音交替；此处按字段归入 suffix。输入的 Jawi 为词根 sama 的拼写。

senses.zh_definition: 相同的；没有区别的，附带确认、强调或认同的语气。
senses.en_definition: The same or alike, with added emphasis or conversational agreement.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak berbeza antara satu dengan yang lain, dengan penegasan melalui partikel -lah.
senses.nuances: 核心意义来自 sama；-lah 的作用取决于语调，可表示确认、亲近或不耐烦。Samalah, saya pun begitu 可理解为“我也一样”。它不是 sama-sama“共同；不客气”的替代形式。

senses.zh_definition: 在地位、程度、资格或价值方面相等、相当的，带强调语气。
senses.en_definition: Equal or equivalent in status, degree, qualification, or value, with emphasis.
senses.ms_definition: Setara atau seimbang dari segi taraf, darjah atau nilai, dengan penegasan.
senses.nuances: 强调某个比较维度上的相等，并不表示两个对象在所有方面完全一致。正式语体可将 samalah 置于句首，突出后面的主语所具有的同等地位。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报：比较两名申请人的学历资格
dual_scenarios.ms: Samalah kedudukan kedua-dua pemohon dari segi kelayakan akademik.
dual_scenarios.zh: 就学历资格而言，两名申请人的条件相同。
dual_scenarios.en: The two applicants stand on equal footing in terms of academic qualifications.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp：朋友发现彼此都还没吃午餐
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kita samalah, dua-dua belum makan lagi.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kita berdua sama-sama belum makan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 咱俩一样，都还没吃呢。
dual_scenarios.en: We're in the same boat—neither of us has eaten yet.
spoken_features: -lah 为陈述加入认同和亲近语气。
dua-dua 是 kedua-duanya 的口语形式。
dah 对应 sudah；nak 对应 hendak；je 对应 sahaja。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah pukul dua, aku belum makan lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah pukul dua, tetapi saya masih belum makan.
messages.zh: 都两点了，我还没吃饭。
messages.en: It's already two, and I still haven't eaten.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kita samalah, dua-dua belum makan lagi. Nak makan kat kedai bawah je?
messages.ms_standard: Kita berdua sama-sama belum makan. Hendak makan di kedai di tingkat bawah sahaja?
messages.zh: 咱俩一样，都还没吃呢。就在楼下那家店吃吧？

etymology.historical_story: Samalah brings together the adjective sama and the emphatic particle -lah. Malay uses this particle in both carefully structured writing and everyday conversation. Its contribution is interactional: an observation about sameness can become reassurance, agreement, or insistence. The word illustrates how a small grammatical attachment carries social meaning without creating a new lexical root. Sources: [sama](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=sama), [-lah](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 sama“相同”，再把 lah 当作语气按钮：samalah ≈“一样啦”。这是记忆提示，不是汉语词源。

etymology.historical_story: Sonia belongs to the international family of names associated with Sophia. It is a spelling variant of Sonya, a Russian diminutive of Sofya; Sophia ultimately comes from Greek vocabulary for wisdom. This history connects names across languages, but it does not make Sonia a Malay word meaning wisdom or identify any particular bearer’s background. [Sources: Sonia](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sonia), [Sonya](https://www.behindthename.com/name/sonya), [Sophia](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Sophia).

etymology.historical_story: Sosej is borrowed from English sausage, with a spelling adapted to Malay pronunciation. The familiar food name illustrates how a borrowed word can become an ordinary Malay noun without acquiring a Malay affix. Its spelling represents the whole borrowed word; the ending is not a productive suffix. [Malay etymology](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/sosej)

etymology.historical_story: Selangkah is transparently formed from se-, meaning one here, and langkah, a step. Its imagery travels easily from walking to planning: a small movement becomes a small advance towards a goal. Repeating the unit in selangkah demi selangkah turns bodily movement into a familiar expression of patient, gradual progress.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se-＝一，langkah＝步：selangkah 就是一步；加 demi selangkah，就像脚印接脚印，一步一步来。

etymology.historical_story: Skala is best learned as a complete technical word rather than divided into Malay affixes. Its meanings link several practices of comparison: reading an instrument, locating a salary grade, and relating a drawing to a real building. Modern usage also applies this comparison of size to projects and businesses, while music uses ordered sequences of pitches.

etymology.historical_story: Spock illustrates how a fictional name can travel across languages through popular culture. Malay speakers discussing Star Trek can retain the name while using Malay grammar around it. The character's Vulcan and human background provides cultural context, but does not explain the name's linguistic origin. No verified derivation of the fictional name is established here. See the [official Star Trek description](https://www.startrek.com/videos/clip-strange-new-worlds-spock-the-human).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Spock 读一个短音节 /spɒk/；把名字与尖耳、逻辑推理的角色形象一起记，勿拆成马来语词根。

morphology.pattern_note: se- 表示“一”，读 /sə/；词根 saat 的两个元音分属不同音节。资料包未提供音节，现按标准形式补全。headword.jawi 按资料包保留 ساعت，但该写法对应词根 saat，未体现派生词的前缀 se-。

word_family.gloss: 一个个时刻；某段关键时光

senses.zh_definition: 一秒，即一分钟的六十分之一；在速率表达中表示每秒。
senses.en_definition: One second, one sixtieth of a minute; per second in expressions of rate.
senses.ms_definition: Satu saat, iaitu satu per enam puluh minit; bagi setiap saat dalam ungkapan kadar.
senses.nuances: 表示时长时译为“一秒”；跟在距离、次数等数量之后时，se- 可表示“每”，如 dua meter sesaat 是“每秒两米”。不要把资料包中 saat 的“时刻”义全部直接移植到 sesaat。[DBP：saat 与 sesaat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=saat)

senses.zh_definition: 片刻；一瞬间，表示很短的时间而非精确的一秒。
senses.en_definition: For a moment; for a very short time.
senses.ms_definition: Untuk waktu yang sangat singkat; seketika.
senses.nuances: 常见于叙述和强调短暂性的表达。日常请人稍候时，sebentar 或 sekejap 通常比 sesaat 更自然；sesaat pun 常与否定词连用，表示“连片刻也不”。

collocations.en: not stop even for a moment

etymology.historical_story: The root saat belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary of time. Its source, Arabic sāʿah, refers to an hour or a period of time, while Malay saat also names the second. Adding the productive Malay prefix se- creates sesaat, connecting this borrowed time word with familiar local word formation. [Research on Arabic loanwords](https://oarep.usim.edu.my/server/api/core/bitstreams/b38963e9-99b5-417c-af79-7f0f570e28db/content)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: se-＝一，saat＝秒：sesaat 就是“一秒”；把秒针跳一下的画面记住，再引申为“一瞬间”。

etymology.historical_story: Spanish developed in English from the name Spain together with the adjectival ending -ish. Its history belongs to English word formation, even when Malaysian speakers insert it into Malay conversation. The same English form can name the language or describe something associated with Spain. For Malay learners, connecting Spanish with bahasa Sepanyol helps distinguish conversational code-switching from standard Malay terminology.

etymology.historical_story: Soda belongs to an international vocabulary connecting mineral chemistry with drinks. European forms historically referred to alkaline substances obtained from plant ash; the American Heritage Dictionary traces English soda through Italian and cautiously suggests an Arabic plant name further back. Malay preserves both chemical and beverage meanings, but this evidence does not establish its immediate borrowing route. [American Heritage](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=soda)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: soda 近似中文「苏打」；后面的词决定是哪一种：penaik 联想糕点膨起，basuh 联想洗涤，air 联想饮料。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: suruhan Tuhan 在宗教讨论中自然，但应尊重听者的信仰背景。职场布置任务宜用 arahan、tugasan，以及带请托语气的 boleh 或 tolong。

etymology.historical_story: Suruhan is formed from suruh, meaning to tell someone to do something, and the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings connect an instruction, the person carrying it out, and, in classical Malay, the act of directing. Expressions such as suruhan Tuhan and orang suruhan show how the same formation operates in religious and social relationships. [DBP: suruhan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=suruhan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: suruh＝叫人做事；加 -an 后，记住两幅画面：“交代下来的事”和“被派去办事的人”。

morphology.pattern_note: 已纠正输入中的 rah 词根分析：交付义的 serah 是完整词根，不能拆为 se- + rah。meN- 和 peN- 接此词根时，起首 s 脱落并出现 ny：menyerah、penyerahan。输入释义中的 sérah → sirah I 属于另一同形词。依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=serah)。

word_family.gloss: 听凭安排；托付自身命运

senses.zh_definition: 把物品、文件或权力交给他人；交出；提交。
senses.en_definition: To hand over, deliver, or submit something to another person or authority.
senses.ms_definition: Memberikan sesuatu kepada pihak lain supaya diterima, disimpan atau dikuasai oleh pihak tersebut.
senses.nuances: serah 常见于口语、祈使句和被动结构；正式主动句通常使用 menyerahkan。例如 Saya serah fail itu kepada puan 是规范的第一人称被动结构。各主要义项参照 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=serah)。

senses.zh_definition: 把任务、责任或决定权交托给某人。
senses.en_definition: To entrust a task, responsibility, or decision to someone.
senses.ms_definition: Mempercayakan urusan atau tanggungjawab kepada seseorang untuk dikendalikan atau diputuskan.
senses.nuances: 重点在委托处理或承担责任，而非实物交付。正式主动表达通常使用 menyerahkan；口语常说 serah kepada 或 serah pada。

collocations.en: to leave it to the experts

senses.zh_definition: 停止抵抗；承认失败；向有权力的一方投降或自首。
senses.en_definition: To surrender, admit defeat, or give oneself up to the authorities.
senses.ms_definition: Menghentikan tentangan, menerima kekalahan atau merelakan diri ditahan oleh pihak berkuasa.
senses.nuances: 常见于 serah diri、serah kalah；正式陈述常用 menyerah diri、menyerah kalah。serah diri 的“自首”含义须有违法行为等语境支持。

collocations.en: to surrender oneself; to turn oneself in

senses.zh_definition: 听凭命运或更高力量安排；把结果托付给上苍。
senses.en_definition: To resign oneself to fate or entrust the outcome to God.
senses.ms_definition: Mempercayakan nasib atau kesudahan sesuatu kepada takdir atau Tuhan.
senses.nuances: 规范表达多用 berserah 或 menyerahkan diri；口语可用 serah。berserah kepada Allah 常表达尽力之后的信托，不能一概理解为消极放弃。

collocations.en: to put one's trust in Allah

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve serah across the language of authority, responsibility and personal fate. Handing over an object, yielding to a ruler and entrusting oneself to God share a transfer of control. This provides a useful historical and cultural connection among its meanings; the consulted entry does not establish its deeper origin. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=serah).

word_family.gloss: 把人钉或绑在十字架上处死

senses.zh_definition: 由两根木条或柱子交叉组成的十字架；也指历史上用于将人绑缚或钉附处死的十字架。
senses.en_definition: A cross made of intersecting pieces of wood, especially one used as an instrument of execution.
senses.ms_definition: Dua batang kayu yang bersilang seperti tanda campur.
senses.nuances: 强调实体结构时常说 kayu salib。历史或宗教叙述中的 mati di atas salib 指在十字架上受刑而死。

collocations.zh: 木制十字架；刑具十字架
collocations.en: a wooden cross; a cross used for execution

senses.zh_definition: 十字形标记或十字架标志，尤指基督宗教的信仰象征，也可指十字架饰物。
senses.en_definition: A cross-shaped sign or object, especially a symbol of Christianity or a cross worn as jewellery.
senses.ms_definition: Tanda berupa garis yang bersilang seperti tanda campur, khususnya sebagai lambang agama Kristian.
senses.nuances: salib 本身不限定是否带有耶稣像，因此 cross 与 crucifix 不能在所有语境中互换。普通几何十字或标记也常用 palang；表示错误的叉号通常用 pangkah。[DBP：salib](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=salib)

collocations.zh: 十字架标记；画十字的手势
collocations.en: a cross symbol; the sign of the cross

etymology.historical_story: Salib comes from Arabic ṣalīb, meaning a cross. An early English–Malay vocabulary explicitly labels the Malay word as Arabic, showing that this borrowing was already established in the historical lexicon. Its Jawi spelling preserves the Arabic form صليب. In modern Malay, the word names both the physical cross and its religious representation. [Historical English–Malay vocabulary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/bc/Vocabulary_of_the_English_and_Malay_languages_%28IA_afu7962.0001.001.umich.edu%29.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sa.lib 两拍想成两根木条：一竖、一横，交成十字架。只是图像助记，不把 sa 或 lib 当作马来语词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根，不能拆成 se- + ksa；e 为 é 音 /e/，音节末 k 可实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。meN- + seksa → menyeksa 时，词首 s 脱落。

word_family.gloss: 遭受折磨；处于痛苦之中

senses.zh_definition: 作为惩罚或受虐而承受的痛苦、苦难；使人痛苦的惩罚或折磨。
senses.en_definition: Torment, suffering, or painful punishment inflicted on someone.
senses.ms_definition: Kesengsaraan atau kesakitan yang dideritai sebagai hukuman; hukuman yang menyakitkan, aniaya atau azab.
senses.nuances: 语义重于普通 hukuman，突出受苦。可用于身体、精神或宗教层面的痛苦；不是所有惩罚都适合称为 seksa。

senses.zh_definition: 痛苦难熬的；饱受折磨的；生活艰难困苦的。
senses.en_definition: Painful, miserable, or difficult to endure.
senses.ms_definition: Pedih, sakit, sengsara atau susah.
senses.nuances: 可以描述生活困境，也可口语化地形容炎热、等待等令人难受的体验。口语中的程度可能带夸张色彩。[DBP：seksa](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=seksa)

senses.zh_definition: 折磨、虐待，或使某人承受身体或精神上的痛苦。
senses.en_definition: To torment, torture, or cause someone to suffer.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan seseorang atau sesuatu mengalami kesakitan atau kesengsaraan; menyeksa.
senses.nuances: 这是 menyeksa 的无 meN- 形式，常见于祈使句和日常口语。正式主动陈述通常用 menyeksa；Jangan seksa diri 则是自然的劝阻表达。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 描述他人的实际苦难时宜表达关切。Jangan seksa diri 可以是亲近关系中的温和劝慰，但需配合体贴语气，避免显得责怪对方。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 朋友之间可用 seksa 夸张地抱怨天气、等待或劳累；面对刚经历虐待、丧失或严重痛苦的人，应谨慎使用玩笑式夸张。azab seksa 常带宗教或严肃惩罚色彩。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 描述他人的实际苦难时宜表达关切。Jangan seksa diri 可以是亲近关系中的温和劝慰，但需配合体贴语气，避免显得责怪对方。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 朋友之间可用 seksa 夸张地抱怨天气、等待或劳累；面对刚经历虐待、丧失或严重痛苦的人，应谨慎使用玩笑式夸张。azab seksa 常带宗教或严肃惩罚色彩。

etymology.historical_story: Seksa belongs to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary and is associated with Sanskrit śikṣā, whose meanings include instruction, discipline, and chastisement. Malay retained the punishment and suffering side of that semantic range. Crawfurd's nineteenth-century dictionary already records seksa as punishment or chastisement, providing historical evidence that this meaning was established well before present-day usage. [Crawfurd, 1852](https://wallace-online.org/converted/pdf/1852_Crawfurd_WS5.2.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 sek.sa 时，第一拍末尾像被突然卡住：联想“难受、受折磨”。再记 menyeksa＝使别人受苦，terseksa＝自己正在受苦。

morphology.pattern_note: seri 是完整词根，不能分析为 ser 加 -i；词包中的 ser 属于误切分。光彩义首音节为 /sə/，词包所引 séri → siri 则属于另一同形词。

senses.zh_definition: 使面容或物体显得明亮动人的光彩、神采。

senses.ms_definition: Cahaya semarak.
senses.nuances: 常指面容的神采，通常用 berseri 表达“容光焕发”。义项依据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=234664&keyword=seri)。

senses.zh_definition: 美感、风采或使人事物显得出众的荣光。
senses.en_definition: Beauty, charm, or splendour.
senses.ms_definition: Kemuliaan, keindahan, kemegahan.
senses.nuances: 可用于装饰、场合及人物带来的风采；不是所有场合都能直接替换 cantik。

senses.zh_definition: 用于王室或受封人士正式称号中的尊称成分。
senses.en_definition: An honorific element in royal and distinguished titles.
senses.ms_definition: Panggilan untuk memuliakan raja atau orang besar.
senses.nuances: 属于称号时写作 Seri；Seri 与 Sri 须依正式称号原样保留。

senses.zh_definition: 比赛双方得分相同、未分胜负的。
senses.en_definition: Tied, with neither side winning.
senses.ms_definition: Sama kedudukan atau mata sehingga tiada pihak yang menang.
senses.nuances: 这是根据体育用法编写的释义，并非词包所引交叉参照的释义。马来西亚比赛规则使用 seri 表示平局，见 [沙巴州政府比赛规则](https://jtu.sabah.gov.my/Publication/data/attachment/757B0420170817150705.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 系列；成套连续作品或项目，现代马来西亚标准语通常写作 siri。
senses.en_definition: A series; a variant referring to siri.
senses.ms_definition: Siri.
senses.nuances: 读 séri /seri/。词包中的 DBP 释文实际指这一义项，不能据此排除光彩、尊称等其他同形词义。现代写作宜用 siri。

etymology.historical_story: The radiance and honorific senses are associated with Sanskrit śrī, meaning splendour or prosperity. In Malay, that prestige survives in ceremonial titles, while everyday expressions bring the same image into faces, rooms, and celebrations. This history concerns the splendour word; it should not automatically be extended to every homograph. See [ANU linguistic research](https://openresearch-repository.anu.edu.au/bitstreams/d747c349-0b87-4c5c-a1e9-adb256c18bc7/download).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 se-ri 想成“色丽”：脸上有神采，房间添光彩。只是记忆联想，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 日语姓氏及品牌专名，整词记忆；su- 不是马来语前缀。IPA 为按马来语音系给出的近似读法，非经核定的专名发音。

senses.en_definition: Suzuki, a Japanese motor manufacturer and brand; by extension, a vehicle of that brand.
senses.ms_definition: Nama syarikat dan jenama kenderaan dari Jepun; mengikut konteks, juga merujuk kepada kenderaan jenama tersebut.
senses.nuances: 正文使用 Suzuki，商标环境可按品牌规范使用 SUZUKI。品牌名不等于摩托车的通称。定义为编辑释义，不能据此声称获 DBP 官方收录；排名仅沿用输入，搭配未经频率核验。[铃木官方历史](https://www.globalsuzuki.com/corporate/history/)

senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Jepun, lazimnya ditulis 鈴木; orang yang dimaksudkan ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 人名与品牌名是不同指称。输入未提供上下文，不能把该词所有出现都归为汽车品牌。以下称谓组合仅示范马来语中的使用方式。

etymology.historical_story: Suzuki's corporate history begins with Michio Suzuki's loom works in Hamamatsu in 1909. The business entered motor vehicles in 1952 and adopted the name Suzuki Motor Co., Ltd. in 1954. The surname thus became familiar internationally as a vehicle brand, explaining why Malay speakers encounter it in transport and commercial contexts. [Source](https://www.globalsuzuki.com/corporate/history/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 su-zu-ki 三段声音与车身上的 Suzuki 标志绑定；先判断说的是“铃木车”还是“铃木先生”。

senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama orang, nama keluarga, nama tempat atau nama jenama, mengikut konteks.

etymology.historical_story: Stanley began as an English place name formed from Old English elements referring to stone and a woodland clearing. Such place names became surnames identifying where families came from; Stanley also developed into a given name. Its historical landscape meaning is not its everyday meaning when naming a person. [Behind the Name](https://surnames.behindthename.com/name/stanley)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作近似“斯坦利”，联想一位叫斯坦利的同事；把声音和人名相连，整词记忆。

senses.zh_definition: 有焦煳气味的，尤指食物、毛发等烧焦后发出的气味。
senses.en_definition: Having a scorched or burnt smell, especially from food or hair.
senses.ms_definition: Hangit, berkenaan bau makanan, rambut atau benda lain yang terbakar.
senses.nuances: 属于 Kamus Dewan 的 sengit I。这里描述的是气味，不是比赛或争论的激烈程度；日常说食物烧焦时，hangit 也很常用。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=sengit)。

collocations.en: the scorched smell of burnt rice

senses.zh_definition: 气味强烈刺鼻的，尤指化学品、气体等。
senses.en_definition: Acrid or sharply pungent, especially of chemicals or gases.
senses.ms_definition: Tajam dan menusuk hidung, berkenaan bau bahan kimia, gas dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 同属 sengit I，强调鼻子受到强烈刺激，不只是一般的“臭”。可译为 acrid 或 pungent，须依据具体物质选择。

senses.zh_definition: 言语尖刻、严厉而伤人的。
senses.en_definition: Harsh, cutting, or hurtful, especially of words or remarks.
senses.ms_definition: Keras dan menyakitkan hati (perkataan), pedas.
senses.nuances: 属于 Kamus Dewan 的 sengit II。用于批评、指责或言辞，强调伤人或尖锐，评价通常偏负面。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=sengit)。

senses.zh_definition: 竞争、战斗、争论等激烈的；双方奋力抗衡的。
senses.en_definition: Fierce, intense, or hotly contested, especially of competition, fighting, or debate.
senses.ms_definition: Hebat atau hangat (perkelahian, pertempuran, perdebatan, dll).
senses.nuances: 属于 sengit II，也是体育、商业及新闻中的常用义。强调对抗强度；是否势均力敌、比分接近或持续很久，仍须由上下文判断。

senses.zh_definition: 神情、举止或回应凶厉、带怒意的。
senses.en_definition: Fierce, angry, or hostile in expression or conduct.
senses.ms_definition: Bengis (perbuatan, muka, dll).
senses.nuances: 属于 sengit II，较常见于叙事或文学描写。形容人的态度时带明显负面色彩，不宜误作“有毅力”的赞美。

Sengit betul 将形容词提前，突出感叹语气。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan separates sengit into numbered entries covering smells and fierce speech, conflict, or behaviour. Its deeper origin is not established by the supplied evidence. The cultural contrast is memorable: a kitchen description may concern a burnt smell, while a sports report concerns fierce competition. These recorded uses should be learned together without inventing a historical progression between them. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=sengit)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用“刺激感强”串联记忆：鼻子受刺激是“刺鼻”，言语刺激人是“尖刻”，双方强力对抗是“激烈”。这是助记联想，不是词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 天体专名，整词记忆；不可拆成马来语 siri 加后缀。音标为英语读音，并非已核实的马来语规范读音。

senses.zh_definition: 天狼星；位于大犬座、从地球观测时夜空中视亮度最高的恒星，其系统包含天狼星 A 和天狼星 B。
senses.en_definition: The brightest star in Earth's night sky, in Canis Major; a binary system comprising Sirius A and Sirius B.
senses.ms_definition: Bintang paling terang di langit malam apabila dilihat dari Bumi, terletak dalam buruj Canis Major dan merupakan sistem dedua yang terdiri daripada Sirius A dan Sirius B.
senses.nuances: 正文写作 Sirius。“最亮”指地球上所见的视亮度，并非所有恒星中本征光度最高。此处采用天文学所指；其他作品、机构或品牌中的同名专名须另凭上下文识别。马来语释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文；官方词条身份未核实，因此 status 为 unverified。

dual_scenarios.en: Sirius is the brightest star in the night sky as seen from Earth.

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 这是中性的天文学专名，没有固有的敬语或贬义色彩；向非专业听众介绍时可先说 bintang Sirius。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于观星、教育和科普讨论。讲述古代信仰时应说明其历史文化属性，避免把相关传说表述为科学因果。

etymology.historical_story: Sirius takes its name from a Greek word meaning scorching or glowing. Its brilliance made it culturally significant long before modern astronomy. Ancient Egyptians associated its seasonal appearance with the Nile's flooding, while Greek and Roman traditions linked it with summer heat and the enduring expression dog days. [Space](https://www.space.com/21702-sirius-brightest-star.html), [Chandra](https://chandra.si.edu/chronicle/0400/sirius.html)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 si-ri-us 分段辅助发音，联想夜空中醒目的一点亮光，再连接中文名“天狼星”；这只是记忆分段。

morphology.pattern_note: 借入后作为不可进一步拆分的词基使用；末尾 -d 不是马来语词缀。派生 menstandardkan、penstandardan 时，借词首辅音群 st- 保留。

senses.zh_definition: 获认可并用于测量、评价或规定事物的标准、准则。
senses.en_definition: An accepted basis for measurement, assessment, or specification.
senses.ms_definition: Asas yang diiktiraf untuk mengukur atau menilai sesuatu; piawai.
senses.nuances: 这是现代马来西亚技术、教育和行政语境的常用义；输入包仅摘录了另列的印尼用法。[DBP：standard](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=standard)。

senses.zh_definition: 生活、表现或品质所达到的水平、程度。
senses.en_definition: A level of living, performance, or quality.
senses.ms_definition: Taraf kehidupan atau darjah mutu sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 着重实际水平；standard kehidupan 通常指生活水平。[DBP：standard](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=standard)。

senses.zh_definition: 被视为价值稳定、可据以衡量其他价值的本位或价值尺度。
senses.en_definition: A reference of fixed value used to measure other values.
senses.ms_definition: Sesuatu yang dianggap tetap nilainya dan digunakan sebagai ukuran nilai.
senses.nuances: 用于经济史和货币制度。standard emas 也可比喻公认的最佳评价基准。[DBP：standard](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=standard)。

senses.zh_definition: 符合通行规范并获正式认可的；尤指语言、拼写等属于标准形式的。
senses.en_definition: Conforming to an accepted norm, especially in language or spelling.

etymology.historical_story: Standard is an international word familiar from English, but Malay dictionaries preserve several distinct uses under its spelling. Modern Malaysian usage centres on benchmarks, quality, living levels, and accepted language forms. The same dictionary also records Indonesian-labelled banner and support meanings. These neighbouring entries show why a single extracted definition can misrepresent a word's everyday role.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用熟悉的 English standard 联想“标准”；再记 bahasa standard 是“规范语言”，standard kehidupan 是“生活水平”。

morphology.pattern_note: 日语来源的文化用语，作为整词使用；shi 不是马来语前缀。音标为日语原词的宽式转写，并非马来语官方读音。

senses.zh_definition: 忍者；日本历史上从事情报搜集、侦察及秘密潜入等任务的人员，也用于相关虚构作品中的人物。
senses.en_definition: A ninja: a covert agent in premodern Japan, or a fictional character based on such an agent.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah Jepun bagi ninja, iaitu orang yang menjalankan tugas perisikan dan penyusupan secara rahsia di Jepun pada zaman dahulu, atau watak fiksyen yang berasaskan golongan tersebut.
senses.nuances: 主要用于日本历史、动漫及游戏语境，不宜直接当作马来语普通词“间谍”的通用替代。作为作品或游戏名称时可写作 Shinobi，其具体所指须另行确定。此处释义为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文；官方收词及规范拼写未核实，因此 status 为 unverified。搭配为自然用语组合，未作语料频率认定。

etymology.historical_story: Shinobi is a historical Japanese designation for people now commonly called ninja. Their work centered on intelligence gathering, with infiltration and disguise among their skills. Mie University's research documents their activities across several centuries. Modern fictional portrayals draw on this history but should not be treated as straightforward historical records. [Mie University](https://ninjacenter.rscn.mie-u.ac.jp/en/ninja/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 shi-no-bi 读，想象一位忍者悄悄走过三个脚步点；把三段声音与秘密行动的画面相连。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语借入的整体词基，通常读一个音节；开头 /sk/ 为辅音群，不必插入元音。派生形式如 penskor 保留词根的 sk。

word_family.gloss: 得分者；评分者，依语境而定

senses.zh_definition: 比赛中个人或队伍取得的分数、进球数，或双方的比分。

senses.ms_definition: Bilangan mata atau jaringan yang diperoleh dalam pertandingan, atau kedudukan angka antara pihak yang bertanding.
senses.nuances: 可指进行中的比分、最终比分或单方得分，并不限于获胜一方。具体运动也常用 mata、gol 或 jaringan。[DBP：skor](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=skor)

senses.zh_definition: 测验、评估或量表按照规定方法计算出的分数或数值。
senses.en_definition: A numerical result calculated for a test, assessment, or rating scale.
senses.ms_definition: Nilai angka yang diperoleh daripada ujian, penilaian atau pengukuran mengikut kaedah tertentu.
senses.nuances: 教育、统计和评估中的常见用法；markah 常指具体评分，skor 也可指标准化或合成后的数值。[马来西亚公共服务局的综合指数计分说明](https://insan.jpa.gov.my/img/front/manual/garis-panduan2023.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 以音乐记谱法写成或印出的乐谱，尤指呈现作品各声部的总谱。
senses.en_definition: A written or printed representation of a musical composition, especially one showing its parts together.
senses.ms_definition: Catatan bertulis atau bercetak bagi sesuatu gubahan muzik dalam bentuk notasi, khususnya yang memperlihatkan bahagian-bahagiannya bersama-sama.
senses.nuances: 常说 skor muzik；这里指乐谱，不是演奏比赛的得分。音乐语境中也可指为影视等作品创作的配乐。[DBP 的音乐对应词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=skor)

senses.zh_definition: 在考试中取得好成绩，或在比赛中得分；属非正式口语用法。
senses.en_definition: Informally, to achieve good examination results or score in a game.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa percakapan, mendapat keputusan peperiksaan yang baik atau memperoleh mata dalam permainan.
senses.nuances: 常见于 nak skor、boleh skor、skor A 等口语表达。正式写作宜按意思改用 mendapat markah tinggi、memperoleh gred A 或 menjaringkan gol；不把英语 score 的其他动词义全部移植进来。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies skor as an English borrowing. Its spelling adapts score to Malay conventions while keeping the recognizable initial consonant cluster. The word serves several professional worlds: spectators follow a match score, assessors calculate numerical results, and musicians read a score. Context determines whether the numbers belong on a scoreboard or the marks belong on a musical staff. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=skor)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: skor 联想英语 score：看球是比分，考试是分数，排练时是乐谱；先看场景再选义。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 构成名词，可指阻隔物、限制或分隔出的空间。词根末尾 t 保留，并与后续元音重新划分音节；开头 se 属于词根，不是前缀 se-。

senses.zh_definition: 隔断；把空间分开的墙、屏障或其他实物。
senses.en_definition: A physical partition or barrier dividing a space.
senses.ms_definition: Benda seperti dinding yang membahagikan sesuatu ruang; sekat.
senses.nuances: 指分隔空间的实物，而不是限制措施，也不是分隔后形成的房间。实际建筑语境也常用 dinding sekat。基本释义来自输入词条；相关阻隔义亦见 [DBP 的 sekatan 检索页](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=sekatan)。

senses.zh_definition: 阻碍或限制；阻止、约束通行、活动或往来的措施，也可指封锁或制裁。
senses.en_definition: An obstacle or restriction on movement or activity, including a blockade or sanctions.
senses.ms_definition: Rintangan atau galangan yang menghalang atau mengehadkan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 具体译法由搭配决定：sekatan jalan raya 通常是道路检查站或路障；sekatan ekonomi 可指经济制裁或经济封锁；sekatan perjalanan 是旅行限制。词本身不必然表示全面禁止。

collocations.en: economic sanctions or an economic blockade

senses.zh_definition: 隔间；经隔断划分而成的房间、格间或空间。
senses.en_definition: A compartment or section formed by partitioning a space.
senses.ms_definition: Ruang seperti bilik yang terbentuk setelah sesuatu tempat dibahagikan dengan sekat.
senses.nuances: 此义指隔出的空间，须与第一义的隔断实物区别。现代语境中 petak、ruang 或 bilik 有时更明确；以下为说明这一较少见词义的组合，不代表固定高频搭配。

collocations.en: divide a hall into several compartments

etymology.historical_story: Sekatan is transparently formed from sekat and the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary senses connect a physical divider, an obstruction, and the compartment created by division. That shared boundary image helps explain its range in present-day Malay, from room partitions to roadblocks and economic restrictions. This is a semantic connection, not a claim about which meaning historically appeared first.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sekat 是“隔开、挡住”，加 -an 就得到“隔挡形成的东西或状态”：隔断、隔间、限制。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入，作为独立词素记忆；词首 str- 是借词辅音群，无马来语词缀。下列词族成员为医学复合术语。

senses.zh_definition: 中风；脑卒中：脑血管阻塞或破裂出血所导致的急性脑功能障碍。
senses.en_definition: An acute disturbance of brain function caused by a blocked blood vessel or bleeding from a ruptured blood vessel in the brain.
senses.ms_definition: Keadaan yang berlaku secara tiba-tiba apabila salur darah ke otak tersumbat atau pecah, lalu merosakkan tisu otak dan menjejaskan fungsinya.

etymology.historical_story: Strok reflects English stroke in Malay spelling, without the final silent e. In Malaysian health communication, it appears alongside angin ahmar, allowing technical and familiar vocabulary to meet. Ministry of Health materials use both expressions when explaining the condition and supporting patients and families through care and rehabilitation. [Malaysian Ministry of Health](https://hq.moh.gov.my/bpkk/images/Kesihatan_Orang_Kurang_Upaya/PDF/Garis_Panduan/11_Manual_Penjagaan_Pesakit_Strok_Angin_Ahmar_di_Peringkat_Penjagaan_Kesihatan_Primer.pdf).

etymology.historical_story: Semut has a rich cultural life in Malay proverbial language. The saying di mana semut mati kalau tidak dalam gula turns an ant's attraction to sugar into a warning about seductive persuasion. The same small creature also supplies an image for human sensations: kesemutan describes tingling as though tiny ants were moving over the skin. [DBP: semut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=semut)

etymology.historical_story: Sedarlah is transparently formed from sedar and the attached particle -lah. Malay uses this particle to give an utterance emphasis, including appeals, instructions, and narrative statements. The form therefore combines awareness or waking with the speaker's stance. Its lesson is grammatical rather than a story about a separate borrowed word. [DBP on particles](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/)

etymology.historical_story: Sebagian transparently combines se- with bagian, a form connected with dividing and shares. Its spelling illustrates a useful regional distinction: Indonesian commonly uses bagian and sebagian, while Malaysian formal writing normally uses bahagian and sebahagian. DBP also records bagian as colloquial. Recognising the relationship helps readers understand neighbouring usage without confusing the two writing standards. See [DBP: bagian](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=bagian).

etymology.historical_story: Samurai comes from Japanese and is historically connected with saburau, meaning to serve. The name recalls service to a superior before its association with a prestigious warrior class. This background makes loyalty and social position central to the word, alongside the armour and swords familiar from films. [Source: PBS NOVA](https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/nova/samurai/hist-nf.html).

senses.zh_definition: 斜置以防物体倾倒的支柱或撑杆；也指供攀缘植物依附的支架。

senses.zh_definition: 赞成或拥护某人、主张或行动；给予鼓励、金钱、劳力等援助。

etymology.historical_story: A slanting prop keeps a structure upright; the sokong word family also expresses support that helps people and proposals succeed. Malay proverbial tradition turns this image into a warning: sokong membawa rebah describes betrayal by someone trusted to help. etymology.historical_story: Seperkara turns the simple combination of se-, meaning one, and perkara, meaning a matter, into a useful way of extending an argument. With lagi, it introduces another point rather than another physical object. Malaysian parliamentary records illustrate its place in public speaking, where a speaker uses the expression to move to an additional concern. [Malaysian Parliament](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/files/hindex/pdf/DN-28021991.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Saintifik belongs to the international vocabulary of science and closely resembles English scientific. Malay treats it as a complete adjective, then applies its own productive morphology in kesaintifikan, meaning scientific character. Its useful cultural distinction is methodological: describing a claim as saintifik invokes scientific principles, rather than simply suggesting that it sounds modern or impressive. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=178260&keyword=saintifik)

etymology.historical_story: The international word stadium ultimately recalls Greek stadion, a measure of length associated with an ancient footrace. The name of the racecourse became a name for the sporting structure itself. The Olympic Museum traces this connection between measurement and architecture; modern Malay uses stadium for venues with spectator seating, whether open or enclosed. [Olympic Museum](https://www.olympics.com/ioc/news/-stadiums-past-and-future-head-to-the-olympic-museum-for-an-exciting-new-exhibition-and-a-whole-lot-more)

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于治疗、祈愿及情感疗愈语境。祷告中的 Sembuhkanlah… 带恳求意味；讨论治疗效果时，sembuhkan 的结果意味比 rawat（治疗、照护）更强。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于治疗、祈愿及情感疗愈语境。祷告中的 Sembuhkanlah… 带恳求意味；讨论治疗效果时，sembuhkan 的结果意味比 rawat（治疗、照护）更强。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary entry for sembuh includes a narrative example mentioning Pagar Ruyung, placing recovery within a traditional Malay storytelling setting. Sembuhkan adds the productive causative suffix -kan: someone causes recovery rather than simply recovering. This grammatical contrast remains useful in modern conversation, while the image of healing also extends naturally to emotional wounds. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=sembuh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sembuh＝病好了；接上使动 -kan，sembuhkan＝让病好起来。

etymology.historical_story: Malay borrowed staf from English staff and adapted its spelling by reducing the doubled final consonant. The word now belongs comfortably to Malaysian institutional life, appearing in universities, offices, hospitals, and military terminology. Its everyday employment sense coexists with the specialized military sense, so context determines whether it means employees or a command-support body.

etymology.historical_story: Senjatamu combines senjata with the possessive clitic -mu. Historical lexicographers connected senjata with Sanskrit vocabulary concerning equipment and readiness; Maxwell's Malay manual records this association. The modern form adds no new weapon type: it simply identifies the possessor. Figurative usage then turns knowledge, arguments, or personal strengths into someone's metaphorical weapons. See [Maxwell's manual](https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/25604/pg25604-images.html).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 senjata＝武器，再把 -mu 接到后面：senjata＋mu＝你的武器；把最后的 mu 当成“归你”的标签。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根记忆，不拆成 se- 加其他成分。首个 e 读 /ə/，第二个 e 读 /e/；ng 表示一个鼻音 /ŋ/。

etymology.historical_story: Selendang belongs to the shared clothing vocabulary of the Malay-Indonesian region and is commonly traced to Javanese sléndang. Its meaning centres on a long cloth draped around the upper body. This helps explain its flexibility: the same garment name can describe a head covering or a shoulder shawl, depending on how it is worn. [Etymology reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/selendang).

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 请求捐助时可说 Sumbangan ikhlas amat dihargai，表达感谢并尊重对方能力，避免以金额衡量诚意。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于慈善、社区互助、学术及工作贡献。说明募款条件时应区分自愿捐助与规定费用；感谢他人的 sumbangan 也可包括时间和劳力。

etymology.historical_story: Sumbangan is transparently formed from the helping sense of sumbang and the noun-forming suffix -an. Kamus Dewan illustrates that word family through assistance at communal celebrations and contributions of time and energy. These examples connect material giving with participation: a useful contribution may be money, practical work, or an idea. [Source: DBP](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=sumbang).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: sumbang 是“出一份力”，加 -an 就把这份帮助变成可说、可数的“捐助或贡献”。
